name: feedback-dialog
title: Feedback dialog
description: Collect product feedback in a small dialog: what kind it is, a message with a counter, an optional email and a thank-you that closes itself.
docs: Pass onSubmit({ type, message, email, metadata }), which may return a promise: the fields lock and the button shows progress, a rejection keeps the text and the button reads Try again, and success shows a thank-you that says where replies go and closes after closeAfterMs (holding still while keyboard focus is on its button), or on Escape. types are idea, problem, praise and other by default, each with a prompt that becomes the placeholder. The counter shows only near maxLength and is read to screen readers at a few steps. askEmail is "optional", "required" or false. metadata, such as the page address, is listed in plain words before it is sent. Ctrl or Cmd with Enter sends. What was typed survives an accidental close. FeedbackPanel is the inside on its own.
